text: Department Of Training & Placement Training and Placement office, established in the early 1990s, operates from a dedicated office on campus. The Training and Placement office houses a team of experienced members that include: Dr. Geetha Kiran A Dean (Corporate Affairs) deanca@mcehassan. ac. in Dr. Jeevan T P Training and Placement Officer tap@mcehassan. ac. in +91 9743448889 / +91 9141305846 Dr. Mohana Lakshmi J Associate Dean (Corporate Affairs) To enhance placement opportunities, a dedicated placement office has also been set up in Bangalore. The office is well-equipped with an exclusive boardroom and five panel rooms, providing all necessary facilities to conduct campus recruitment programs. Student Enrollment and Placement Process Student enrolment for placement begins at the start of the Sixth semester.

title: Malnad College of Engineering
text: A comprehensive database of enrolled students is maintained to facilitate hiring programs. Following enrolment, department-wise orientation sessions are conducted to highlight the significance of placements and related training. Training and Skill Development Initiatives To prepare students for recruitment, a series of structured training programs are implemented: An introductory session on career growth, planning, and available opportunities is conducted to the first year students. Recognizing the importance of communication skills, a mandatory credit course in Professional English is introduced in the first year, followed by training in communication and soft skills in subsequent years. A two-week intensive aptitude and soft skills training is organized after the sixth-semester exams, conducted by expert trainers.

title: Malnad College of Engineering
text: This program is also a mandatory credit course A specialized crash course in C and C++ is provided to students from non-circuit branches to meet software industry requirements. Guest lectures by industry experts are regularly arranged to keep students updated on the latest technological advancements. Campus Recruitment and Higher Education Guidance The campus hiring programs have been highly successful, with top companies like TCS, HCL, Wipro, BEL, Accenture, Tech Mahindra, Tata Elxsi, Rane Industries, Goodrich Aerospace, Nokia Siemens Networks, Mindtree, Flowserve India Controls, TDPS, Ramky Infrastructures, L&T (IES)Schneider, Hive Minds, Incresco, Voya India, Infosys Finacle, Yokogawa, Honey Well and many more recruiting students. Beyond placements, the department conducts awareness sessions on higher education opportunities in India and abroad.

title: Malnad College of Engineering
text: Expert lectures highlight the importance of GATE, GRE, TOEFL, IELTS, and other competitive exams to encourage students to explore further studies. Support for Students The TPO maintains a repository of previous years' aptitude test questions, interview puzzles, and placement-related materials, encouraging students to practice thoroughly. The laboratory is used for competitive exams on weekends, generating revenue for the institute. Students are encouraged to attend pool campus recruitment drives and VTU-organized placements, increasing their job opportunities. Since 2018, a Placement Awareness Talk is delivered during the induction program for newly admitted students. This session provides insights into career options, placements, higher studies, and competitive exams, ensuring students start preparing early for their future.

text: Through these initiatives, the Training and Placement office remains committed to enhance students' employability and bridging the gap between academia and industry. MCE HR Synergy In an effort to strengthen industry–academia collaboration and gain valuable insights into contemporary human resource practices, the institution organized “MCE HR Synergy” under the leadership of the Dean of Corporate Affairs, in association with the Training and Placement Cell. The event served as a strategic platform for interaction between academia and industry, bringing together senior HR professionals to share perspectives on talent development, employability, and evolving industry expectations. Through meaningful dialogue and networking, the initiative aimed to enhance institutional engagement with industry and align academic outcomes with professional requirements.

text: Process Process EXAMINATION Malnad College of Engineering, Hassan is an autonomous institute, affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University, Belgaum. The institute formulates the academic curriculum as per the needs of the industry and new developments in the various fields. The examination for the autonomous courses is conducted by the Institute. The evaluation process is carried out in two stages. Continuous Internal Evaluation [CIE] during the progress of the semester and Semester End Examination [SEE] conducted at the end of the semester. The examination section conducts the Semester End Examination and the evaluation process in coordination with the departments. text: Home Idea Development Evaluation and Application (IDEA) LAB, introduced by AICTE, New Delhi, is a movement in the country to enhance required skill in youths to make them employable in the engineering domain. Aim is also to expose our next generation to the advanced tools and technology available at the global standard. Malnad College of Engineering is proud to receive this prestigious project, which is one among 49 institutions in the country and one among 5 institutions in Karnataka state. We are happy that the present IDEA LAB has been inaugurated by our Honourable higher education minister of Govt. of Karnataka on 26th April 2022. The total cost of the project is 96. 3 lakhs; 50% of the grant is provided by AICTE and another 50% by our college management.

title: Malnad College of Engineering
text: This is one of the AICTE Quality Improvement Schemes (AQIS) launched by Govt of India, which would align with the New Education Policy (NEP) to emphasis experience-based learning. The stakeholders of the IDEA LAB are students and faculty members of all types of colleges and schools, local industry people, farmers, alumni, dropout students/unemployed youth in village/urban area. Such state of-the-art facility has been established in the college campus area of more than 4000 square feet. The lab will be kept open for 24/7 for all its stakeholders to make their own schedule of training and working. Motto of the MCE-IDEA lab is to train up a person to design and prepare a prototype of a product starting from its scratch.

title: Malnad College of Engineering
text: Vision: MCE AICTE IDEA LAB envisions becoming a hub for innovation and hands-on learning, fostering a global-standard ecosystem where individuals transform ideas into tangible prototypes to address real-world challenges. Mission: Our mission is to empower a diverse range of stakeholders, indluding students, faculty, industry professionals, formers, alumni, and unemployed youth, by providing round-the-clock access to advanced tools, interdisciplinary collaboration, and prototype-centric training aligning with NEP-2020 and AQIS-AICTE goals for experiential learning.
